The intermediate nodes X1 and X2 split the 30 Ω resistors (N_a3‑N_b1 and N_b2‑N_c1) into 20 Ω + 10 Ω each, which is confirmed by the measurements involving X1 and X2. Therefore the circuit consists of ten individual resistors in series, with the connections listed below.</thought>
